differences.what: Woofer trim ring: in A it is a flat, evenly saturated matte blue band with no shading, so it reads as a painted decal pasted on the front; in B the same ring carries a soft top-to-bottom gradient and a gentle specular sheen that makes it read as a moulded or anodised part catching the key light

B's lit ring separates the woofer from the busy blue interior behind it, so the main driver reads as the focal point; in A the flat ring merges into the cabinet's blue tones and the outline of the woofer goes soft
